tEn: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer
tZh: CogVideoX: 带专家 Transformer 的文本到视频扩散模型
sEn: CogVideoX achieves state-of-the-art text-to-video generation using a 3D VAE for spatial-temporal compression, an expert Transformer with adaptive LayerNorm for deep text-video fusion, and multi-resolution training for coherent long-duration videos.
sZh: CogVideoX 通过 3D VAE 实现时空压缩、带自适应层归一化的专家 Transformer 实现深度文本-视频融合、以及多分辨率训练生成连贯长视频，达到文本到视频生成的领先水平。
absEn: We present CogVideoX, a large-scale text-to-video generation model based on diffusion transformer, which can generate 10-second continuous videos aligned with text prompt, with a frame rate of 16 fps and resolution of 768 * 1360 pixels. Previous video generation models often had limited movement and short durations, and is difficult to generate videos with coherent narratives based on text. We propose several designs to address these issues. First, we propose a 3D Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to compress videos along both spatial and temporal dimensions, to improve both compression rate and video fidelity. Second, to improve the text-video alignment, we propose an expert transformer with the expert adaptive LayerNorm to facilitate the deep fusion between the two modalities. Third, by employing a progressive training and multi-resolution frame pack technique, CogVideoX is adept at producing coherent, long-duration, different shape videos characterized by significant motions. In addition, we develop an effective text-video data processing pipeline that includes various data preprocessing strategies and a video captioning method, greatly contributing to the generation quality and semantic alignment. Results show that CogVideoX demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across both multiple machine metrics and human evaluations. The model weight of both 3D Causal VAE, Video caption model and CogVideoX are publicly available at https://github.com/THUDM/CogVideo.
absZh: 我们提出了 CogVideoX，一个基于扩散 Transformer 的大规模文本到视频生成模型，能够生成与文本提示对齐的 10 秒连续视频，帧率为 16 fps，分辨率为 768×1360 像素。以前的视频生成模型通常运动有限、持续时间短，且难以基于文本生成具有连贯叙事的视频。我们提出了几种设计来应对这些问题。首先，我们提出了一种 3D 变分自编码器（VAE），在空间和时间两个维度上压缩视频，以提高压缩率和视频保真度。其次，为了改善文本-视频对齐，我们提出了一种专家 Transformer，带有专家自适应层归一化，以促进两种模态之间的深度融合。第三，通过采用渐进式训练和多分辨率帧打包技术，CogVideoX 擅长生成连贯、长时间、不同形状且具有显著运动的视频。此外，我们开发了一个有效的文本-视频数据处理流程，包括多种数据预处理策略和一种视频描述方法，大大提高了生成质量和语义对齐。结果表明，CogVideoX 在多个机器指标和人工评估中均展现出最先进的性能。3D 因果 VAE、视频描述模型和 CogVideoX 的模型权重已在 https://github.com/THUDM/CogVideo 公开。

paras.en: We present CogVideoX, a large-scale text-to-video generation model based on diffusion transformer, which can generate 10-second continuous videos that align seamlessly with text prompts, with a frame rate of 16 fps and resolution of 768 × 1360 pixels. Previous video generation models often struggled with limited motion and short durations. It is especially difficult to generate videos with coherent narratives based on text. We propose several designs to address these issues. First, we introduce a 3D Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to compress videos across spatial and temporal dimensions, enhancing both the compression rate and video fidelity. Second, to improve text-video alignment, we propose an expert transformer with expert adaptive LayerNorm to facilitate the deep fusion between the two modalities. Third, by employing progressive training and multi-resolution frame packing, CogVideoX excels at generating coherent, long-duration videos with diverse shapes and dynamic movements. In addition, we develop an effective pipeline that includes various pre-processing strategies for text and video data. Our innovative video captioning model significantly improves generation quality and semantic alignment. Results show that CogVideoX achieves state-of-the-art performance in both automated benchmarks and human evaluation. We publish the code and model checkpoints
paras.zh: 我们提出了 CogVideoX，一种基于扩散 Transformer 的大规模文本到视频生成模型，能够生成与文本提示无缝对齐的 10 秒连续视频，帧率为 16 fps，分辨率为 768 × 1360 像素。以往的视频生成模型常常面临运动幅度有限和持续时间短的问题，尤其是根据文本生成具有连贯叙事的视频更是困难。我们提出了多项设计来解决这些问题。首先，我们引入了 3D 变分自编码器（VAE），在空间和时间维度上压缩视频，从而提高了压缩率和视频保真度。其次，为了改善文本与视频的对齐，我们提出了一种带有专家自适应 LayerNorm 的专家 Transformer，以促进两种模态之间的深度融合。第三，通过采用渐进式训练和多分辨率帧打包，CogVideoX 擅长生成具有多样形状和动态运动的连贯长时视频。此外，我们构建了一个高效的流水线，包含针对文本和视频数据的多种预处理策略。我们创新的视频字幕模型显著提升了生成质量和语义对齐。结果表明，CogVideoX 在自动基准测试和人工评估中均达到了最先进的性能。我们公开了代码和模型检查点

paras.en: The code of CogVideoX, along with our VAE model and video captioning model, is available at https://github.com/THUDM/CogVideo.

paras.en: The rapid development of text-to-video models has been phenomenal, driven by both the Transformer architecture (Vaswani et al., 2017) and diffusion model (Ho et al., 2020). Early attempts to pretrain and scale Transformers to generate videos from text have shown great promise, such as CogVideo (Hong et al., 2022) and Phenaki (Villegas et al., 2022). Meanwhile, diffusion models have recently made exciting advancements in video generation (Singer et al., 2022; Ho et al., 2022). By using Transformers as the backbone of diffusion models, i.e., Diffusion Transformers (DiT) (Peebles & Xie, 2023), text-to-video generation has reached a new milestone, as evidenced by the impressive Sora showcases (OpenAI, 2024). Despite these rapid advancements in DiTs, it remains technically unclear how to achieve long-term consistent video generation with dynamic plots. For example, previous models had difficulty generating a video based on a prompt like “a bolt of lightning splits a rock, and a person jumps out from inside the rock”. In this work, we train and introduce CogVideoX, a set of large-scale diffusion transformer models designed for generating long-term, temporally consistent videos with rich motion semantics. We address the challenges mentioned above by developing a 3D Variational Autoencoder, an expert Transformer, a progressive training pipeline, and a video data filtering and captioning pipeline, respectively. First, to efficiently consume high-dimensional video data, we design and train a 3D causal VAE that compresses the video along both spatial and temporal dimensions. Compared to previous method (Blattmann et al., 2023) of fine-tuning 2D VAE, this strategy helps significantly reduce the sequence length and associated training compute and also helps prevent flicker in the generated videos, that is, ensuring continuity among frames. Second, to improve the alignment between videos and texts, we propose an expert Transformer with expert adaptive LayerNorm to facilitate the fusion between the two modalities. To ensure the temporal consistency in video generation and capture large-scale motions, we propose to use 3D full attention to comprehensively model the video along both temporal and spatial dimensions. Third, as most video data available online lacks accurate textual descriptions, we develop a video captioning pipeline capable of accurately describing video content. This pipeline is used to generate new textual descriptions for all video training data, which significantly enhances CogVideoX’s ability to grasp precise semantic understanding. Figure 2: The performance of openly-accessible text-to-video models in different aspects. In addition, we adopt and design progressive training techniques, including multi-resolution frame pack and resolution progressive training, to further enhance the generation performance and stability of CogVideoX. Furthermore, we propose Explicit Uniform Sampling, which stabilizes the training loss curve and accelerates convergence by setting different timestep sampling intervals on each data parallel rank. To date, we have completed the CogVideoX training with two sizes: 5 billion and 2 billion, respectively. Both machine and human evaluations suggest that CogVideoX-5B outperforms well-known video models and CogVideoX-2B is very competitive across most dimensions. Figure 2 shows the performance of CogVideoX-5B and CogVideoX-2B in different aspects. It shows that CogVideoX has the property of being scalable. As the size of model parameters, data volume, and training volume increase, the performance will get better in the future.
paras.zh: 基于 Transformer 架构（Vaswani 等人，2017）和扩散模型（Ho 等人，2020）的推动，文本到视频模型的快速发展令人瞩目。早期尝试预训练并扩展 Transformer 以从文本生成视频的工作已展现出巨大潜力，例如 CogVideo（Hong 等人，2022）和 Phenaki（Villegas 等人，2022）。与此同时，扩散模型近年来在视频生成领域取得了令人振奋的进展（Singer 等人，2022；Ho 等人，2022）。通过将 Transformer 作为扩散模型的主干，即扩散 Transformer（DiT）（Peebles 和 Xie，2023），文本到视频生成达到了一个新的里程碑，Sora 令人印象深刻的展示（OpenAI，2024）即为明证。尽管 DiT 取得了这些快速进展，但如何在动态情节下实现长期一致的视频生成在技术上仍不明确。例如，之前的模型难以根据“一道闪电劈开岩石，一个人从岩石内部跳出”这样的提示生成视频。在这项工作中，我们训练并介绍了 CogVideoX，一组大规模扩散 Transformer 模型，旨在生成具有丰富运动语义的长期、时间一致的视频。我们通过分别开发 3D 变分自编码器、专家 Transformer、渐进式训练流程以及视频数据过滤和字幕生成流程来应对上述挑战。首先，为高效处理高维视频数据，我们设计并训练了一个 3D 因果 VAE，它在空间和时间两个维度上压缩视频。与之前微调 2D VAE 的方法（Blattmann 等人，2023）相比，该策略有助于显著降低序列长度和相关训练算力，也有助于防止生成视频中的闪烁，即确保帧间连续性。其次，为改善视频与文本之间的对齐，我们提出了一种带专家自适应层归一化的专家 Transformer，以促进两种模态之间的融合。为确保视频生成中的时间一致性并捕捉大规模运动，我们提出使用 3D 全注意力机制，在时间和空间维度上对视频进行全面建模。第三，由于网上大多数视频数据缺乏准确的文本描述，我们开发了一个能够准确描述视频内容的视频字幕生成流程。该流程用于为所有视频训练数据生成新的文本描述，显著增强了 CogVideoX 捕捉精确语义理解的能力。图 2：开放获取的文本到视频模型在不同方面的性能。此外，我们采用并设计了渐进式训练技术，包括多分辨率帧打包和分辨率渐进训练，以进一步提升 CogVideoX 的生成性能和稳定性。此外，我们提出了显式均匀采样（Explicit Uniform Sampling），通过在每个数据并行等级上设置不同的时间步采样间隔，来稳定训练损失曲线并加速收敛。迄今为止，我们已完成两个规模的 CogVideoX 训练：分别有 5B 和 2B 参数。机器和人工评估均表明，CogVideoX-5B 优于知名的视频模型，而 CogVideoX-2B 在大多数方面具有很强的竞争力。图 2 展示了 CogVideoX-5B 和 CogVideoX-2B 在不同方面的性能，表明 CogVideoX 具有可扩展性。随着模型参数规模、数据量和训练量的增加，未来其性能将进一步提升。

paras.en: • We propose CogVideoX, a simple and scalable structure with a 3D causal VAE and an expert transformer, designed for generating coherent, long-duration, high-action videos. It can generate long videos with multiple aspect ratios, up to 768×1360 resolution, 10 seconds in length, at 16fps. • We evaluate CogVideoX through automated metric evaluation and human assessment, compared with openly-accessible top-performing text-to-video models. CogVideoX achieves state-of-the-art performance. • We publicly release our 5B and 2B models, including text-to-video and image-to-video versions, the first commercial-grade open-source video generation models. We hope it can advance the field of video generation.
paras.zh: • 我们提出了 CogVideoX，一种简单且可扩展的结构，采用 3D 因果 VAE 和专家 Transformer，旨在生成连贯、长时长、高动作性的视频。它可以生成长达 10 秒、16fps、分辨率高达 768×1360、具有多种宽高比的视频。• 我们通过自动化指标评估和人工评估，将 CogVideoX 与开放获取的顶尖文本到视频模型进行比较。CogVideoX 达到了最先进的性能。• 我们公开发布了 5B 和 2B 模型，包括文本到视频和图像到视频版本，这是首批商业级开源视频生成模型。我们希望这能推动视频生成领域的发展。

paras.en: In this section, we present the CogVideoX model. Figure 3 illustrates the overall architecture. Given a pair of video and text inputs, we design a 3D causal VAE to compress the video into the latent space, and the latents are then patchified and unfolded into a long sequence denoted as \(z_{\text{vision}}\). Simultaneously, we encode the textual input into text embeddings \(z_{\text{text}}\) using T5 (Raffel et al., 2020). Subsequently, \(z_{\text{text}}\) and \(z_{\text{vision}}\) are concatenated along the sequence dimension. The concatenated embeddings are then fed into a stack of expert transformer blocks. Finally, the model outputs are unpatchified to restore the original latent shape, which is then decoded using a 3D causal VAE decoder to reconstruct the video. We illustrate the technical design of the 3D causal VAE and expert transformer in detail.
paras.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍 CogVideoX 模型。图 3 展示了整体架构。给定一对视频和文本输入，我们设计了一个 3D 因果 VAE 将视频压缩到潜空间，然后对潜变量进行分块（patchify）并展开为长序列，记为 \(z_{\text{vision}}\)。同时，我们使用 T5（Raffel et al., 2020）将文本输入编码为文本嵌入 \(z_{\text{text}}\)。随后，\(z_{\text{text}}\) 和 \(z_{\text{vision}}\) 沿序列维度拼接。拼接后的嵌入被送入一组专家 Transformer 块。最后，模型输出被逆分块（unpatchify）以恢复原始潜变量形状，然后使用 3D 因果 VAE 解码器解码以重建视频。我们详细阐述了 3D 因果 VAE 和专家 Transformer 的技术设计。

paras.en: we propose to implement a video compression module based on 3D variational autoencoders (Yu et al., 2023b). The idea is to incorporate three-dimensional convolutions to compress videos both spatially and temporally. This can help achieve a higher compression ratio with largely improved quality and continuity of video reconstruction.
paras.zh: 我们提出基于 3D 变分自编码器（Yu et al., 2023b）的视频压缩模块。其核心思想是引入三维卷积，在空间和时间上压缩视频。这有助于实现更高的压缩比，同时大幅提升视频重建的质量和连续性。

paras.en: that the model can encode larger resolution videos well without additional training as it has no attention modules, but this is not effective when encoding videos with more frames. Therefore, we conduct a two-stage training by first training on 17-frame videos and fine-tuning by context parallel on 161-frame videos. Both stages utilize a weighted combination of the L1 reconstruction loss, LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018) perceptual loss, and KL loss. After a few thousand training steps, we additionally introduce the GAN loss from a 3D discriminator.
paras.zh: 该模型没有注意力模块，因此无需额外训练即可较好地编码更高分辨率的视频，但在编码帧数更多的视频时效果不佳。因此，我们采用两阶段训练：首先在 17 帧视频上训练，然后通过上下文并行在 161 帧视频上进行微调。两个阶段均使用 L1 重建损失、LPIPS（Zhang et al., 2018）感知损失和 KL 损失的加权组合。经过数千步训练后，我们额外引入来自 3D 判别器的 GAN 损失。

paras.en: We introduce the design choices in Transformer for CogVideoX, including the patching, positional embedding, and attention strategies.
paras.zh: 我们介绍了 CogVideoX 中 Transformer 的设计选择，包括分块（patching）、位置嵌入（positional embedding）和注意力机制策略。

The video latents are then patchified, generating sequence \(z_{\text{vision}}\) of length \(T/q · H/p · W/p\). When q > 1, we repeat the first frame of videos and

paras.zh: 图像放在序列的开头，以便实现图像和视频的联合训练。

paras.en: We mix images and videos during training, treating each image as a single-frame video. Additionally, we employ progressive training from the resolution perspective. For the diffusion setting, we adopt v-prediction (Salimans & Ho, 2022) and zero SNR (Lin et al., 2024), following the noise schedule used in LDM (Rombach et al., 2022).
paras.zh: 在训练过程中，我们将图像和视频混合，把每张图像视为单帧视频。此外，我们从分辨率角度采用渐进式训练。对于扩散设置，我们采用 v-prediction（Salimans & Ho, 2022）和 zero SNR（Lin et al., 2024），并遵循 LDM（Rombach et al., 2022）中使用的噪声调度。

paras.en: Previous video training methods often involve joint training of images and videos with a fixed number of frames (Singer et al., 2022; Blattmann et al., 2023). However, this approach usually leads to two issues. First, there is a significant gap between the two input types using bidirectional attention, with images having one frame while videos having dozens of frames. We observe that models trained this way tend to diverge into two generative modes based on the token count and not to have good generalizations. Second, to train with a fixed duration, we have to discard short videos and truncate long videos, which prevents full utilization of the videos of varying number of frames. For different resolutions, SDXL (Podell et al., 2023) uses a bucketed approach to address the issue of generating cropped images, but it makes the data and training pipeline more complex. To address these issues, we chose mixed-duration training, which means training videos of different lengths together. However, inconsistent data shapes within the batch make training difficult. Inspired by Patch n' Pack (Dehghani et al., 2024), we place videos of different duration (also different resolutions) into the same batch to ensure consistent shapes within each batch, a method we refer to as Multi-Resolution Frame Pack, illustrated in Figure 6. We use 3D RoPE to model the position relationship of various video shapes. There are two ways to adapt RoPE to different resolutions and durations. One approach is to expand the position encoding table and, for each video, select the front portion of the table according to the resolution (extrapolation). The other is to scale a fixed-length position encoding table to match the resolution of the video (interpolation). Considering that RoPE is a relative position encoding, we chose the first approach to keep the clarity of model details.
paras.zh: 之前的视频训练方法通常涉及对图像和固定帧数的视频进行联合训练（Singer 等，2022；Blattmann 等，2023）。然而，这种方法通常会导致两个问题。首先，在使用双向注意力时，两种输入类型之间存在显著差距：图像只有一帧，而视频有数十帧。我们观察到，以这种方式训练的模型往往会根据 token 数量分化为两种生成模式，并且不具备良好的泛化能力。其次，为了使用固定的时长进行训练，我们不得不丢弃短视频并截断长视频，这导致无法充分利用帧数各异的视频。针对不同的分辨率，SDXL（Podell 等，2023）采用分桶（bucketed）方法来解决生成裁剪图像的问题，但这使得数据和训练流程更加复杂。为了解决这些问题，我们选择了混合时长训练，即将不同长度的视频一起训练。然而，批次内不一致的数据形状使得训练变得困难。受 Patch n' Pack（Dehghani 等，2024）的启发，我们将不同时长（以及不同分辨率）的视频放入同一个批次，以确保每个批次内的形状一致，我们将这种方法称为多分辨率帧打包（Multi-Resolution Frame Pack），如图 6 所示。我们使用 3D RoPE 来建模不同视频形状之间的位置关系。有两种方法可以使 RoPE 适应不同的分辨率和时长。一种方法是扩展位置编码表，并根据每个视频的分辨率选取该表的前部（外推法）。另一种方法是缩放固定长度的位置编码表，以匹配视频的分辨率（内插法）。考虑到 RoPE 是一种相对位置编码，我们选择了第一种方法以保持模型细节的清晰性。

paras.en: Videos from the Internet usually include a significant amount of low-resolution ones. Directly training on high-resolution videos is extremely expensive. To fully utilize data and save costs, the model is first trained on 256px videos to learn semantic and low-frequency knowledge. Then it is trained on gradually increased resolutions, from 256px to 512px and then 768px, to learn high-frequency knowledge. To maintain the ability to generate videos with different aspect ratios, we keep the aspect ratio unchanged and resize the short side to the above resolutions.
paras.zh: 互联网上的视频通常包含大量低分辨率视频。直接在高分辨率视频上训练成本极高。为了充分利用数据并节省成本，模型先在 256px 视频上训练，以学习语义和低频知识；然后逐步提高分辨率，从 256px 到 512px，再到 768px 进行训练，以学习高频知识。为了保持生成不同宽高比视频的能力，我们保持宽高比不变，将短边缩放到上述分辨率。

paras.en: Finally, we perform a high-quality fine-tuning (see Appendix A). Moreover, we trained an image-to-video model based on the above model; see Appendix D for details.
paras.zh: 最后，我们进行高质量微调（见附录 A）。此外，我们基于上述模型训练了一个图像到视频模型，详见附录 D。

paras.en: Ho et al. (2020) define the diffusion training objective as \[ L_{\mathrm{simple}}(\theta) := \mathbb{E}_{t,x_0,\epsilon} \| \epsilon - \epsilon_{\theta}( \sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_t} x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_t} \epsilon, t) \|^2, \tag{1} \], where t is uniformly distributed between 1 and T. The common practice is for each rank in the data parallel group to uniformly sample a value between 1 and T, which is theoretically equivalent to Equation (1). However, in practice, the results obtained from such random sampling are often not sufficiently uniform; since the magnitude of the diffusion loss is related to the timesteps, this can lead to significant fluctuations in the loss. Thus, we propose to use Explicit Uniform Sampling to divide the range from 1 to T into n intervals, where n is the number of ranks. Each rank then uniformly samples within its respective interval. This method ensures a more uniform distribution of timesteps. As shown in Figure 10(d), the loss curve from training with Explicit Uniform Sampling is noticeably more stable.
paras.zh: Ho 等人 (2020) 将扩散训练目标定义为 \[ L_{\mathrm{simple}}(\theta) := \mathbb{E}_{t,x_0,\epsilon} \| \epsilon - \epsilon_{\theta}( \sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_t} x_0 + \sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_t} \epsilon, t) \|^2, \tag{1} \]，其中 t 在 1 到 T 之间均匀分布。通常的做法是让数据并行组中的每个 rank 在 1 到 T 之间均匀采样一个值，这在理论上等价于公式 (1)。然而在实践中，这种随机采样的结果往往不够均匀，而且由于扩散损失的幅度与时间步有关，这可能导致损失出现显著波动。因此，我们提出使用显式均匀采样（Explicit Uniform Sampling）将 1 到 T 的范围划分为 n 个区间，其中 n 为 rank 数量。每个 rank 在其对应区间内均匀采样。该方法保证了时间步的分布更加均匀。如图 10(d) 所示，使用显式均匀采样训练得到的损失曲线明显更稳定。

paras.en: We construct a collection of relatively high-quality video clips with text descriptions by applying video filters and recaptioning models. After filtering, approximately 35M single-shot clips remain, with each clip averaging about 6 seconds. We additionally use 2B images filtered with aesthetics score from LAION-5B (Schuhmann et al., 2022) and COYO-700M (Byeon et al., 2022) datasets to assist training.
paras.zh: 我们通过视频过滤器和重标注模型，构建了一个包含文本描述的高质量视频片段集合。过滤后，约 3500 万个单镜头片段保留下来，每个片段平均时长约 6 秒。此外，我们还使用了来自 LAION-5B (Schuhmann et al., 2022) 和 COYO-700M (Byeon et al., 2022) 数据集的、经过美学评分过滤的 20 亿张图像来辅助训练。

paras.en: Video Filtering. Video generation models should capture the dynamic nature of the world. However, raw video data often contains significant noise for two intrinsic reasons: First, artificial editing during video creation can distort the true dynamic information; Second, video quality may suffer due to filming issues such as camera shake or subpar equipment. In addition to the intrinsic quality of the videos, we also consider how well the video data supports model training. Videos with minimal dynamic information or lacking connectivity in dynamic aspects are considered detrimental. Consequently, we have developed a set of negative labels, which include:
paras.zh: 视频过滤。视频生成模型应捕捉世界的动态本质。然而，原始视频数据往往包含大量噪声，原因有二：其一，视频制作过程中的人为剪辑会扭曲真实的动态信息；其二，视频质量可能因拍摄问题（如相机抖动或设备不佳）而受损。除了视频的固有质量外，我们还要考虑视频数据对模型训练的支持程度。动态信息极少或动态方面缺乏连贯性的视频被认为是有害的。因此，我们制定了一组负面标签，包括：

paras.en:
• Editing: Videos that have undergone noticeable artificial processing, such as re-editing and special effects, which compromise visual integrity.
• Lack of Motion Connectivity: Video segments with transitions that lack coherent motion, often found in artificially spliced videos or those edited from static images.
• Low Quality: Poorly shot videos with unclear visuals or excessive camera shake.
• Lecture Type: Videos focusing primarily on a person continuously talking with minimal effective motion, such as lectures and live-streamed discussions.
• Text Dominated: Videos containing a large amount of visible text or primarily focusing on textual content.
• Noisy Screenshots: Videos captured directly from phone or computer screens, often characterized by poor quality.
paras.zh:
• 剪辑：经过明显人工处理的视频，如重新剪辑和特效，破坏了视觉完整性。
• 运动缺乏连贯性：过渡缺乏连贯运动的视频片段，常见于人工拼接的视频或由静态图像编辑而成的视频。
• 低质量：拍摄不佳的视频，画面不清晰或相机抖动过度。
• 讲座型：主要聚焦于一个人持续讲话、有效运动极少的视频，如讲座和直播讨论。
• 文本主导：包含大量可见文本或主要聚焦文本内容的视频。
• 噪声截图：直接从手机或电脑屏幕录制的视频，通常质量较差。

paras.en: We conducted ablation studies on some of the designs mentioned in Section 2 to verify their effectiveness.
paras.zh: 我们对第 2 节中提到的部分设计进行了消融实验，以验证其有效性。

paras.en: Position Embedding. We compared 3D RoPE with sinusoidal absolute position embedding. As shown in Figure 10a, the loss curve of RoPE converges significantly faster than the absolute one. This is consistent with the common choice in LLMs.
paras.zh: 位置嵌入。我们将 3D RoPE 与正弦绝对位置嵌入进行了比较。如图 10a 所示，RoPE 的损失曲线收敛速度明显快于绝对位置嵌入。这与 LLMs 中的常见选择一致。

paras.en: Expert Adaptive Layernorm. We compare three architectures in Figures 8a, 8d, and 10c: MMDiT (Esser et al., 2024), Expert AdaLN (CogVideoX), and without Expert AdaLN.
paras.zh: 专家自适应层归一化。我们在图 8a、8d 和图 10c 中比较了三种架构：MMDiT（Esser 等，2024）、Expert AdaLN（CogVideoX）以及不带 Expert AdaLN 的架构。

paras.en: Cross-attention DiT has been shown to be inferior to MMDiT in (Esser et al., 2024), so we do not repeat it. According to FVD, CLIP4Clip (Luo et al., 2022) score, and loss, expert AdaLN significantly outperforms the model without expert AdaLN and MMDiT with the same number of parameters. We infer that expert adaptive layernorm is enough to alleviate the difference in feature space between the two modalities. So two independent transformers in MMDiT are not necessary, which greatly increases the number of parameters. Moreover, the design of Expert AdaLN is more simplified than MMDiT and is closer to current LLMs, making it easier to scale up further.
paras.zh: 交叉注意力 DiT 已在（Esser 等，2024）中被证明不如 MMDiT，因此我们不再重复。根据 FVD、CLIP4Clip（Luo 等，2022）分数和损失，Expert AdaLN 显著优于不带 Expert AdaLN 的模型以及相同参数量的 MMDiT。我们推断专家自适应层归一化足以缓解两种模态之间的特征空间差异。因此，MMDiT 中两个独立的 Transformer 并非必要，它们大大增加了参数量。此外，Expert AdaLN 的设计比 MMDiT 更简化，更接近当前的 LLMs，使其更容易进一步扩展。

paras.en: 3D Full Attention. In Figures 8b and 10b, when we replace 3D full attention with 2D + 1D attention, the FVD becomes much higher than with 3D attention in early steps. We also observe that 2D+1D is unstable and prone to collapse. We suppose that as the model size increases, such as 5B, training becomes more prone to instability, placing higher demands on the structural design. The 2D+1D structure, as discussed in Section 2.2, is not suitable for video generation tasks, which could lead to instability during training.
paras.zh: 3D 全注意力。在图 8b 和图 10b 中，当我们将 3D 全注意力替换为 2D+1D 注意力时，FVD 在早期步骤中远高于 3D 注意力。我们还观察到 2D+1D 不稳定且容易崩溃。我们推测，随着模型规模的增大，例如 5B，训练更容易变得不稳定，这对结构设计提出了更高的要求。如第 2.2 节所讨论的，2D+1D 结构不适合视频生成任务，这可能导致训练过程中的不稳定性。

paras.en: Explicit Uniform Sampling. From Figure 8c and Figure 10d, we find that using Explicit Uniform Sampling can make a more stable decrease in loss and get a better performance. In addition, in Table 9 we compare the loss at each diffusion timestep alone between two choices for a more precise comparison. We find that the loss at all timesteps is lower with explicit uniform sampling, indicating that this method can also accelerate loss convergence. We suppose that this is because the loss of different timesteps varies greatly. When the timesteps sampled for training are not uniform enough, the loss fluctuates greatly due to the above randomness. Explicit uniformity can reduce randomness, thereby bringing a common decrease in all timesteps.
paras.zh: 显式均匀采样。从图 8c 和图 10d 中，我们发现使用显式均匀采样可以使损失更稳定地下降，并获得更好的性能。此外，在表 9 中，我们比较了两种选择在每个扩散时间步上的损失，以进行更精确的比较。我们发现，使用显式均匀采样时，所有时间步的损失都更低，表明该方法也能加速损失收敛。我们推测这是因为不同时间步的损失差异很大。当训练采样的时间步不够均匀时，由于上述随机性，损失会大幅波动。显式均匀性可以减少随机性，从而在所有时间步上带来共同的下降。

paras.en: 4.2.1 Automated Metric Evaluation VAE Reconstruction Effect. We compared our 3DVAE with other open-source 3DVAEs on 256 × 256 resolution 17-frame videos, using the validation set of WebVid (Bain et al., 2021a). In Table 2, our VAE achieved the best PSNR and exhibited the least jitter. Notably, other VAE methods use fewer latent channels than ours.
paras.zh: 4.2.1 自动指标评估：VAE 重建效果。我们在 256 × 256 分辨率、17 帧视频上，使用 WebVid (Bain et al., 2021a)的验证集，将我们的 3DVAE 与其他开源 3DVAE 进行比较。在表 2 中，我们的 VAE 取得了最好的 PSNR，并且抖动最小。值得注意的是，其他 VAE 方法使用的潜在通道比我们少。

paras.en:
Evaluation Metrics. To evaluate the performance of text-to-video generation, we employ several metrics in Vbench (Huang et al., 2024) that are consistent with human perception: Human Action, Scene, Dynamic Degree, Multiple Objects, and Appearance Style. Other metrics, such as color, tend to give higher scores to simple, static videos, so we do not use them.

评估指标。为了评估文本到视频生成的性能，我们采用了 Vbench (Huang et al., 2024) 中与人类感知一致的若干指标：人类动作、场景、动态程度、多物体和外观风格。其他指标如色彩，往往会给简单、静态的视频较高分数，因此我们不使用它们。

paras.en: For longer-generated videos, some models might produce videos with minimal changes between frames to get higher scores, but these videos lack rich content. Therefore, metrics for evaluating the dynamism become important. To address this, we use two video evaluation tools: Dynamic Quality (Liao et al., 2024) and GPT4o-MTScore (Yuan et al., 2024). Dynamic Quality is defined by the integration of various quality metrics with dynamic scores, mitigating biases arising from negative correlations between video dynamics and video quality. GPT4o-MTScore is a metric designed to measure the metamorphic amplitude of time-lapse videos using GPT-4o, such as those depicting physical, biological, and meteorological changes.
paras.zh: 对于生成的较长视频，一些模型可能会在帧间产生最小变化以获得更高分数，但这些视频缺乏丰富内容。因此，评估动态性的指标变得重要。为此，我们使用了两种视频评估工具：动态质量 (Liao et al., 2024) 和 GPT4o-MTScore (Yuan et al., 2024)。动态质量由各种质量指标与动态分数的集成定义，以减轻视频动态性与视频质量之间负相关所产生的偏差。GPT4o-MTScore 是一种使用 GPT-4o 测量延时视频变化幅度的指标，例如描述物理、生物和气象变化的视频。

paras.en: Results. Table 3 provides the performance comparison of CogVideoX and other models. CogVideoX-5B achieves the best performance in five out of the seven metrics and shows competitive results in the remaining two metrics. These results demonstrate that the model not only excels in video generation quality but also outperforms previous models in handling various complex dynamic scenes. In addition, Figure 2 presents a radar chart that visually illustrates the performance advantages of CogVideoX. We present the time and space consumption during inference at different resolutions in appendix A.
paras.zh: 结果。表 3 提供了 CogVideoX 与其他模型的性能比较。CogVideoX-5B 在七个指标中的五个上取得了最佳性能，并在其余两个指标上表现出竞争性结果。这些结果表明，该模型不仅在视频生成质量上表现出色，而且在处理各种复杂动态场景方面也优于先前的模型。此外，图 2 展示了雷达图，直观地说明了 CogVideoX 的性能优势。我们在附录 A 中提供了不同分辨率下推理时的时间和空间消耗。

paras.en:
4.2.2 Human Evaluation

In addition to automated scoring mechanisms, we also establish a comprehensive human evaluation framework to assess the general capabilities of video generation models. Evaluators score the generated videos on four aspects: Sensory Quality, Instruction Following, Physics Simulation, and Cover Quality, using three levels: 0, 0.5, or 1. Each level is defined by detailed guidelines. The specific details are provided in Appendix J. We compare Kling (2024.7), one of the best closed-source models, with CogVideoX-5B under this framework. The results shown in Table 4 indicate that CogVideoX-5B wins the human preference over Kling across all aspects.

Table 4: Human evaluation between CogVideoX and Kling.
paras.zh:
4.2.2 人工评估

除了自动化评分机制外，我们还建立了一个全面的人工评估框架，以评估视频生成模型的通用能力。评估者将从四个方面对生成的视频进行评分：感官质量、指令遵循、物理模拟和覆盖质量，使用三个等级：0、0.5 或 1。每个等级都有详细的指南定义。具体细节见附录 J。在此框架下，我们将 Kling（2024.7）这一最佳闭源模型之一与 CogVideoX-5B 进行对比。表 4 所示的结果表明，CogVideoX-5B 在所有方面均优于 Kling，赢得了人类偏好。

paras.en: In this paper, we present CogVideoX, a state-of-the-art text-to-video diffusion model. It leverages a 3D VAE and an Expert Transformer architecture to generate coherent long-duration videos with significant motion. We are also exploring the scaling laws of video generation models and aim to train larger and more powerful models to generate longer and higher-quality videos, pushing the boundaries of what is achievable in text-to-video generation.
paras.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 CogVideoX，一种最先进的文本到视频扩散模型。它利用 3D VAE 和专家 Transformer 架构来生成具有显著运动的连贯长时视频。我们还在探索视频生成模型的缩放定律，旨在训练更大、更强的模型来生成更长、更高质量的视频，从而突破文本到视频生成的边界。

paras.en: High-Quality Fine-Tuning. Since the filtered pre-training data still contains a certain proportion of dirty data, such as subtitles, watermarks, and low-bitrate videos, we selected a subset of higher quality video data, accounting for 20% of the total dataset, for fine-tuning in the final stage. This step effectively removed generated subtitles and watermarks and slightly improved the visual quality. However, we also observed a slight degradation in the model’s semantic ability.
paras.zh: 高质量微调。由于过滤后的预训练数据仍含有一定比例的不干净数据，如字幕、水印和低码率视频，我们选取了一部分质量更高的视频数据（占总数据集的 20%）用于最后阶段的微调。这一步有效去除了生成的字幕和水印，并略微提升了视觉质量。然而，我们也观察到模型的语义能力略有下降。

paras.en: Visualizing different RoPE interpolation methods. When adapting low-resolution position encoding to high-resolution, we consider two different methods: interpolation and extrapolation. We show the effects of two methods in Figure 9. Interpolation tends to preserve global information more effectively, whereas the extrapolation better retains local details. Given that RoPE is a relative position encoding, we chose the extrapolation to maintain the relative position between pixels.
paras.zh: 不同 RoPE 插值方法的可视化。在将低分辨率位置编码适配到高分辨率时，我们考虑了两种不同的方法：插值和外推。我们在图 9 中展示了两种方法的效果。插值倾向于更有效地保留全局信息，而外推则更好地保留局部细节。鉴于 RoPE 是一种相对位置编码，我们选择外推以保持像素之间的相对位置。

paras.en: **D. Image-to-Video Model.** We fine-tune an image-to-video model from the text-to-video model. Following (Blattmann et al., 2023), we add an image as an additional condition alongside the text. The image is passed through a 3D VAE and concatenated with the noised input along the channel dimension. Similar to super-resolution tasks, there is a significant distribution gap between training and inference (the first frame of videos vs. real-world images). To enhance the model’s robustness, we add large noise to the image condition during training. Some examples are shown in Figures 13 and 14. CogVideoX can handle different styles of image input.
paras.zh: **D. 图像到视频模型。** 我们基于文本到视频模型微调得到图像到视频模型。借鉴 (Blattmann et al., 2023)，我们在文本之外额外引入图像作为条件。图像经过 3D VAE 后，在通道维度上与带噪输入拼接。与超分辨率任务类似，训练和推理之间存在显著分布差距（视频首帧 vs. 真实图像）。为增强模型鲁棒性，我们在训练时对图像条件加较大噪声。一些示例如图 13 和图 14 所示。CogVideoX 能够处理不同风格的图像输入。

paras.en: **E. Related Works.** *Video diffusion models.* Generating videos has been explored through various types of generative models, such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) (Yu et al., 2022; Tulyakov et al., 2018), autoregressive methods (Hong et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2021), and non-autoregressive methods (Villegas et al., 2022; Yu et al., 2023a). Diffusion models have recently gained significant attention, achieving remarkable results in both image generation (Rombach et al., 2022; Esser et al., 2024) and video generation (Singer et al., 2022; Blattmann et al., 2023; Guo et al., 2023). However, the limited compression ratio and simple training strategy often restrict the generation to low-resolution, short-duration videos (2–3 seconds), requiring multiple super-resolution and frame interpolation models to be cascaded (Singer et al., 2022; Ho et al., 2022) for a generation. This leads to generated videos with limited semantic information and minimal motion.
paras.zh: **E. 相关工作。** *视频扩散模型。* 视频生成已经通过多种生成模型进行探索，例如生成对抗网络（GANs）(Yu et al., 2022; Tulyakov et al., 2018)、自回归方法 (Hong et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2021) 和非自回归方法 (Villegas et al., 2022; Yu et al., 2023a)。扩散模型近来受到广泛关注，在图像生成 (Rombach et al., 2022; Esser et al., 2024) 和视频生成 (Singer et al., 2022; Blattmann et al., 2023; Guo et al., 2023) 方面均取得了显著成果。然而，有限的压缩率和简单的训练策略通常使生成局限于低分辨率、短时长（2–3 秒）的视频，需要级联多个超分辨率和帧插值模型 (Singer et al., 2022; Ho et al., 2022) 才能完成一次生成。这导致生成的视频语义信息有限且动态幅度极小。

paras.en: *Video VAEs.* To increase the compression ratio of videos and reduce computation costs, a common approach is to encode the video into a latent space using a Variational Autoencoder (VAE), which is also widely used in image generation. Early video models usually directly use an image VAE for generation. However, modeling only the spatial dimension can result in jittery videos. SVD (Blattmann et al., 2023) attempts to fine-tune the image VAE decoder to solve the jittering issue. However, this approach cannot take advantage of the temporal redundancy in videos and still cannot achieve an optimal compression rate. Recently, some video models (Zheng et al., 2024b; Lab & etc., 2024) try to use a 3D VAE for temporal compression, but small latent channels still result in blurry and jittery videos.
paras.zh: *视频 VAE。* 为提高视频压缩率并降低计算成本，一种常见做法是使用变分自编码器（VAE）将视频编码到潜空间，这一做法在图像生成中也被广泛使用。早期视频模型通常直接使用图像 VAE 进行生成。然而，仅对空间维度建模会导致视频抖动。SVD (Blattmann et al., 2023) 尝试微调图像 VAE 解码器以解决抖动问题，但这种方法无法利用视频的时间冗余，仍然无法达到最优压缩率。近年来，一些视频模型 (Zheng et al., 2024b; Lab & etc., 2024) 尝试使用 3D VAE 进行时间压缩，但较小的潜通道仍会导致视频模糊和抖动。

paras.en: **F. Caption Upsampler.** To ensure that the text input distribution during inference is as close as possible to the distribution during training, similar to (Betker et al., 2023), we use a large language model to upsample the user’s input during inference, making it more detailed and precise. A fine-tuned LLM can generate better prompts than zero/few-shot. For image-to-video, we use a vision-language model to upsample the prompt, such as GPT-4V, CogVLM (Wang et al., 2023a).
paras.zh: **F. 文本描述上采样器。** 为确保推理时的文本输入分布尽可能接近训练时的分布，与 (Betker et al., 2023) 类似，我们在推理时使用大语言模型对用户输入进行上采样，使其更详细、更精确。微调后的 LLM 比零样本/少样本能生成更好的提示词。对于图像到视频，我们使用视觉语言模型（如 GPT-4V、CogVLM (Wang et al., 2023a)）对提示词进行上采样。

paras.en: You are part of a team of bots that create videos. You work with an assistant bot that will draw anything you say in square brackets. For example, outputting “a beautiful morning in the woods with the sun peeking through the trees” will trigger your partner bot to output a video of a forest morning, as described. You will be prompted by people looking to create detailed, amazing videos. The way to accomplish this is to take their short prompts and make them extremely detailed and descriptive. There are a few rules to follow: You will only ever output a single video description per user request. When modifications are requested, you should not simply make the description longer. You should refactor the entire description to integrate the suggestions.

paras.en:
I. Video-to-Video via CogVideoX and CogVLM2-Caption
In this section, we present several examples of video-to-video generation using CogVideoX and CogVLM2-Caption. Specifically, we first input the original video into CogVLM2-Caption to obtain the video's caption, and then feed this caption into the CogVideoX model to generate a new video. From the examples below, it can be seen that our pipeline achieves a high degree of fidelity to the original video, showing that CogVLM2-Caption can capture almost all the details in the video.
paras.zh:
I. 基于 CogVideoX 和 CogVLM2-Caption 的视频到视频生成
在本节中，我们展示了一些使用 CogVideoX 和 CogVLM2-Caption 进行视频到视频生成的示例。具体来说，我们首先将原始视频输入到 CogVLM2-Caption 中以获取视频的描述，然后将该描述输入到 CogVideoX 模型中以生成新视频。从下面的示例可以看出，我们的流程对原始视频实现了高度保真，表明 CogVLM2-Caption 能够捕捉视频中的几乎所有细节。

paras.en:
J. Human Evaluation Details
One hundred meticulously crafted prompts are used for human evaluators, characterized by their broad distribution, clear articulation, and well-defined conceptual scope. A panel of evaluators is instructed to assign scores for each detail on a scale from 0 to 1, with the overall total score rated on a scale from 0 to 5, where higher scores reflect better video quality. To better complement automated evaluation, human evaluation emphasizes the instruction-following capability: the total score cannot exceed 2 if the generated video fails to follow the instructions.
Sensory Quality: This part focuses mainly on the perceptual quality of videos, including subject consistency, frame continuity, and stability.
paras.zh:
J. 人工评估细节
我们使用了一百个精心设计的提示词用于人工评估，这些提示词具有分布广泛、表述清晰、概念范围明确的特点。评估小组被要求对每个细节在 0 到 1 的范围内打分，总体总分在 0 到 5 的范围内评分，分数越高表示视频质量越好。为了更好地补充自动化评估，人工评估强调指令遵循能力：如果生成的视频未能遵循指令，总分不能超过 2。
感官质量：这部分主要关注视频的感知质量，包括主体一致性、帧连续性和稳定性。

paras.en:
Score Evaluation Criteria
1 High sensory quality: 1. The appearance and morphological features of objects in the video are completely consistent. 2. High picture stability, maintaining high resolution consistently. 3. Overall composition/color/boundaries match reality. 4. The picture is visually appealing.
0.5 Average sensory quality: 1. The appearance and morphological features of objects in the video are at least 80% consistent. 2. Moderate picture stability, with only 50% of the frames maintaining high resolution. 3. Overall composition/color/boundaries match reality by at least 70%. 4. The picture has some visual appeal.
0 Poor sensory quality: large inconsistencies in appearance and morphology, low video resolution, and composition/layout not matching reality.
paras.zh:
评分标准
1 高质量感官质量：1. 视频中物体的外观和形态特征完全一致。2. 画面稳定性高，始终保持高分辨率。3. 整体构图/色彩/边界与现实相符。4. 画面具有视觉吸引力。
0.5 中等感官质量：1. 视频中物体的外观和形态特征至少 80% 一致。2. 画面稳定性中等，仅 50% 的帧保持高分辨率。3. 整体构图/色彩/边界与现实至少 70% 相符。4. 画面具有一定的视觉吸引力。
0 感官质量差：外观和形态存在较大不一致，视频分辨率低，构图/布局与现实不符。
